SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.engineering.pid

Class ProfessionalPidPackageExporter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.pid.ProfessionalPidPackageExporter
public final class ProfessionalPidPackageExporter extends Object
Coordinates a DEXPI 2.0.1 P&ID proposal, native drawings and its executable simulation handoff.

The package preserves unresolved projection, engineering and simulation gaps. A saved runnable process does not turn unbound proposals into implemented controls or safeguards. Drawing and named-tool acceptance remain explicit review tasks.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa
